g.text: The same firms and exactly the same coordinates as figure 28, recoloured by where the head office was: the difference between the two pictures is therefore the encoding, not a second layout. Of the 30 backbone firms
with a recoverable address, 47% were run from metropolitan France. 25 have no recoverable address and stay grey — that is not a fourth category.
